# The clock period each design of the timing corpus achieves under Vivado
# 2026.1's timer at xc7a100tftg256-3: each clock's period less the worst setup
# slack from it to itself, in ns. tools/vivado-parity/achieved.sh and
# `achieved.py table --fixture`; docs/fpga-vivado-parity.md, "Placement and
# routing against Vivado's own flow". Run on 2026-11-06.
#   vivado <design> <clock> <ns>    Vivado's own flow, synthesis to routes, the
#                                   best of three runs at tightening periods
#   netlist <design> <clock> <ns>   Vivado's placement and routes of the
#                                   `before` build's netlist, seed 1
#   reticle <build> <seed> <design> <clock> <ns>
#                                   Reticle's placement and routes, timed by
#                                   Vivado: `before` is 04b70219, `after` with
#                                   the section's changes, both `--delay-model vivado`;
#                                   `synthesis` is `after` with the default `--synthesis
#                                   vivado` (docs/fpga-vivado-parity.md, "Synthesis
#                                   against Vivado's"), `after` being what `--synthesis
#                                   legacy` builds
#                                   `area` is `synthesis` with "Area against
#                                   Vivado's" (2026-11-07); `packing` is `area` with
#                                   "Packing against Vivado's" (2026-11-07), the
#                                   default now
